meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and a call at 4:40. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that, and why didn't anyone call me first?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure says the same. What else do you have, Hale?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

"If you keep fighting this." I'm writing that down, Hale, word for word. Procedure 4.4 says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing goes in his record, so you're threatening him to make me stop, and the principal will hear it from me before I leave this building.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen get an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: at her opening position, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "your son cheated", because it attacked Owen with no document behind it, and the later record threat gave her a reason to go to the principal.
Try next time: when she asked "What else do you have, Hale?", own that the zero went in before you called her, then show one dated document about Owen's own work instead of repeating the score.
